summary: Closed Phase 9 (Deduplicate the Extension Install/Uninstall Pair): extracted install-extension.sh/uninstall-extension.sh's mutual duplication into a new lib/extension-install-lib.sh (validation/logging preamble plus generic extlib_install_symlinks/extlib_remove_symlinks helpers covering all six per-type symlink loops), after first writing the pair's first-ever characterization test (17 cases, since has_test was false for both) and verifying it green before and after the refactor. Deliberately preserved a genuine pre-existing behavioral discrepancy (install_agents never checked an existing symlink's target, unlike install_commands/install_skills) rather than normalizing it away. NET-PROD -70 (a header-only-extraction first attempt landed +13 with no later phase to pay it back, so the extraction was widened to the symlink-loop bodies, the larger duplicate mass); duplicate-block count for the pair dropped 35/35 -> 6/6. NET-TEST +274 (the new characterization suite, a one-time required cost). Verification: run-all.sh --only for the new suite (17/17), full-corpus shellcheck clean (0 findings/415 files), manifest-sync suite green after registering the new lib and test in manifest.json. Per the phase's own declared local tier, no full redeploy/gate battery was run (deferred to Phase 20's full tier). Hit the SAME recurring git-commit-phase.sh double-slash containment bug that already hit Phases 7 and 8's closing commits (dropped the new test file and manifest.json from the phase-closing commit); recovered via the established follow-up-commit pattern. 11 of 20 plan phases remain, starting with Phase 10 (typst script pair deduplication).
